repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the candidate checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the candidate triggered an action when the volume was held at 20 (a rise from 0), whereas the IR requires a drop of at least 20 units. The arithmetic operand order was inverted.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction in the condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's requirement that the initial volume minus the final volume is at least 20.
